notes.title: We have launched a Kickstarter campaign!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42015983/9ce2e00af3a7a0eae4e29cffb11f040782186f67.png

We are now working to increase the number of characters, scenarios, and cinematics. And more customization of animations, special attacks,  super combos, phrases, and slogans of each president, to create epic and fun fights.

We want to dedicate more resources to creating the best game possible, and that's why we have launched a Kickstarter campaign where you can already support us.

You will be able to get a customized version of the game with a character with your face and many more rewards.

Visit the campaign website now
